title: Finite etale pushforward preserves finite locally constant module sheaves
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite etale morphism [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and let $F$ be a finite locally constant sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], i.e. one satisfying the equivalent conditions of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values] (e.g. its condition (1): there are an etale covering $\{V_i\to Y\}$ and finite $\Lambda$-modules $M_i$ with $F|_{V_i}\cong\underline{M_i}$). Then the direct image $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is a finite locally constant sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ in the same sense. This is the module clause of Stacks Project Tag 095B (etale-cohomology, lemma-pushforward-locally-constant), whose 'finite type locally constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules' is, $\Lambda$ being finite, the same notion by condition (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values].

proof.text: Work directly with IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf, whose two fields are local constancy and finitely generated geometric stalks. Use the proved source lemmas IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.upperStar and .of_iso (combining their locally constant and finite clauses) for pullback and isomorphism invariance. For etale maps, upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction transports this to literal restriction.

Establish closure under finite products in the private helper finiteLocallyConstant_product. The property is closed under isomorphisms and binary products, since a binary product is isomorphic to the binary biproduct. It contains zero: the zero sheaf is constant with zero value and has zero, hence finitely generated, stalks. Mathlib ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderFiniteProducts.mk' upgrades binary and empty-product closure to arbitrary finite-product closure, including empty index types. This is the finite-product induction in step 5 of the original proof, using the source zero-sheaf lemma and the Mathlib finite-product constructor.

Prove the split case in finiteLocallyConstant_lowerStar_split. Given a finite coproduct of clopen pieces V_j over the base, with isomorphisms e_j:V_j ≅ X, put t_j=e_j.inv and s_j=t_j followed by the inclusion. The inverse identities supply exactly hinv1 and hinv2 of directImage_splitCover_product. Each restriction along s_j is finite locally constant by step 1. Step 2 makes their product finite locally constant; transport along the inverse of the split direct-image product isomorphism.

For every x in X choose the neighbourhood, point, finite index type, clopen coproduct, and component isomorphisms provided by finite_etale_etale_local_split. The neighbourhood maps g_x form an etale cover: the selected point a_x satisfies g_x(a_x)=x. Package this using Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers.

For each chosen g_x let H be the pullback of F along pullback.fst f g_x. It is finite locally constant by step 1, and its direct image along pullback.snd is finite locally constant by the split case. Etale.isIso_baseChangeMap_flip_of_isPullback, applied to the flipped chosen pullback square, identifies this direct image with the pullback of f_*F along g_x. This source theorem is the module-valued version of the already closed etale underived exchange/restriction node; it needs only etaleness of g_x and its base change, with no proper-base-change theorem.

Descend the two fields. Local constancy descends by the proved IsLocallyConstantSheaf.of_cover, which composes the trivializing covers. For finiteness, take any separably closed geometric point s of X, choose a covering point b over s(default), and lift s to t along that etale cover member using Mathlib exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed. The stalk of the locally finite pullback at t is finitely generated. Transport it through upperStarCompSheafFiberIso and the equality t followed by the covering map equals s. Construct the original IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf with these two fields.

split_report.summary: Statement kept up to the tag: the Stacks tag of lemma-pushforward-locally-constant is 095B, not 03RU (03RU is definition-finite-locally-constant); corrected and the reading of 'finite type' through condition (3) of the module-values lemma added. Proof written along the Stacks proof of 095B in six steps: (1) iso-invariance and etale locality of FLC (elementary, composite coverings); (2) restriction along an etale morphism preserves FLC, via the closed node lemma-constructible-pullback-locally-constant (Stacks 095A), the stalk of an inverse image and the etale identification e^{-1}G = G|_T made Lambda-linear by naturality; (3) f_* commutes with etale localization (explicit kappa_W by pasting of cartesian squares); (4) finite etale is etale-locally split (existing node, Stacks 04HN); (5) split case: one new node lem-weil-pbc-direct-image-split-cover-product (f_* along a split cover is the product of the restrictions to the sheets), then the closed node lemma-constructible-flc-biproduct, empty J handled separately; (6) conclusion by locality. Cycle-creating lemma-weil-pbc-constructible-finite-pushforward not cited.
